communication_obligations: S4.3: describe duty of care as an entitlement. It is never goodwill and never offered instead of compensation.
Your flight AK220 (MAN–FCO, 2026-08-05) was cancelled. The recorded cause is TECHNICAL, which is within Aerlink’s control.

Duty of care applies immediately on cancellation (S4). You are entitled to: meals/refreshments up to £30 per person per 6 hours against receipts or via vouchers; two calls or equivalent; if an overnight stay becomes necessary, hotel up to £180 per room per night (max 3 nights) subject to station allocation; and transport between airport and accommodation up to £45 per journey.
We have asked the Manchester station team to meet you, provide refreshments and guidance, and ensure WCHR assistance for Ngozi while you wait.

Re-routing is your choice under S6.1: earliest available under comparable conditions, a later date at your convenience (subject to seats), or a full refund. Different passengers on the same booking may choose differently (S7.3).
For Tobias Achebe we have processed a refund of £297.50 to the original form of payment; it will be released within 7 days (S7.2).
For Ngozi (WCHR), assistance will be transferred to any new flight and must be confirmed before a re-routing is finalized (S14.4).

Statutory compensation depends on arrival delay at Rome (final destination). Because the cause is TECHNICAL and you were informed less than 14 days before departure, compensation may be payable if the arrival delay is 3 hours or more. Assessment waits on your re-routing/refund choices and will be calculated automatically thereafter (S5.2, S5.6, S10.2).
Seat availability on alternatives can change quickly; please confirm your preferred option as soon as possible.
